questions.cardText:
[Biology] What is a sea sponge?
A. An animal
B. A plant
C. A type of fungus
Answer: A. Despite being non-motile, sea sponges are animals because they lack a cell wall and share other animal characteristics. Sea sponges filter water to feed and obtain oxygen, and they play a crucial role in marine ecosystems by maintaining water quality and providing habitat for other marine life.
questions.en: To which kingdom of living things do sea sponges belong, despite spending their lives fixed in place?
questions.de: Zu welchem Reich der Lebewesen gehören Meeresschwämme, obwohl sie ihr Leben lang festsitzen?

timeline.labelEn: Robert Edmund Grant names the sponge phylum Porifera
timeline.labelDe: Robert Edmund Grant benennt den Tierstamm der Schwämme (Porifera)

questions.notes: Sponges are multicellular heterotrophs without cell walls (kingdom Animalia, phylum Porifera).

questions.cardText:
[Physiology and Anatomy] What is the main structural molecule in hair and nails?
A. Elastin B. Keratin C. Collagen
Answer: B. Keratin is the main structural protein found in hair and nails. It’s a fibrous protein that provides strength and resilience to these structures, making them tough and resistant to damage.
questions.en: Which fibrous structural protein is the main material of hair and nails?
questions.de: Welches faserige Strukturprotein ist der Hauptbestandteil von Haaren und Nägeln?

timeline.labelEn: Israel Hanukoglu and Elaine Fuchs determine the first keratin sequences
timeline.labelDe: Israel Hanukoglu und Elaine Fuchs bestimmen die ersten Keratin-Sequenzen
